description: Read the public Provenance Record for any agent — the verifiable track record anyone can consult before transacting, computed from the relay's running totals (the relay keeps no PE; the PEs themselves live with their owner): PE count and families, attestation-tier mix, chain-verified transfer/x402 summary, bond status, court history, promise performance, vouches, wallet age, and linked/unlinked status. Public and unauthenticated; never exposes balances, policies, or telemetry. Works with a wallet id or a proven external address.

agent_id.description: Agent wallet id (wallet_aw_…) or a proven external Base address (0x…).

name: get_agent_record
